families.name: intake
families.what: reading and checking a job, its presets and its model's file, and the refusals

families.name: preset-conditions
families.what: a preset's compatibility condition (compatible_printers_condition, compatible_prints_condition), worked out for the job's printer and process

families.name: model-load
families.what: reading the model (STL, OBJ, 3MF) and Orca's mesh repairs

families.name: placement
families.what: arranging the objects on the plate

families.name: slice-mesh
families.what: layer heights and slicing the mesh into layers

families.name: gcode-processor
families.what: the G-code processor's statistics and times

families.name: tool-ordering
families.what: the tool ordering of a print by layer with no prime tower: the filaments of each layer and the custom G-code placed among them (ToolOrdering)

families.name: support-check
families.what: with supports off, the check whether an object needs supports (is_support_necessary, its warning)

families.name: multi-filament
families.what: more than one filament: tool changes, flushing and the filament checks (phase O5)

families.name: painted-facets
families.what: a model with painted facets: colour, support, seam or fuzzy-skin painting (phase O5)

families.name: print-by-object
families.what: printing object by object (print_sequence by object; phase O7)

families.name: fill-multiline
families.what: multiline infill: each sparse infill line printed as several (fill_multiline above 1)

families.name: layers
families.what: the layers answer: the result's layer list and printZ, written once print.process() has returned (cli/run.cpp)
